    Right tau-sequences for the literal right-module category #

    At a nonprojective indecomposable, the chosen minimal right almost-split map and its kernel form the usual Auslander--Reiten complex. At a projective indecomposable, the boundary complex is 0 ⟶ rad P ⟶ P. Finite componentwise biproducts extend these label meshes to every finitely generated right module.
